description: Ministry of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Worker in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in the cocoa, cardamom, and pepper trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the implementation of a specific legal provision (Section 20(2)(b) of the Ordinance) to determine worker compensation based on a cost of living index, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
